# ScriptClientHud

*Client*

One element of the vanilla Minecraft HUD of the client player, such as the hotbar, hearts or chat. Changes apply from the next frame, stay until [`reset()`](#reset) or until the player leaves the world, and are visible only to this player.

```js
var hotbar = c.getPlayer().getMinecraftHud("hotbar");

hotbar.setPosition(0, -20);  // 20 GUI pixels higher
hotbar.setScale(1.5);        // 1.5 times larger, still centered at the bottom
c.getPlayer().getMinecraftHud("food").setRender(false);
```

## Methods

### getId {#getid}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the element ID, for example `"hotbar"`.

:::

### setPosition {#setposition}

::: member

Moves the element away from where Minecraft draws it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | horizontal offset in GUI pixels (scaled by the GUI scale setting), positive to the right |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | vertical offset in GUI pixels, positive down |

:::

### getX {#getx}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — horizontal offset in GUI pixels set by [`setPosition(float, float)`](#setposition), 0 by default.

:::

### getY {#gety}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — vertical offset in GUI pixels set by [`setPosition(float, float)`](#setposition), 0 by default.

:::

### setScale {#setscale}

::: member

Resizes the element around its anchor on the screen, so it stays at the same edge: the hotbar, hearts, food, air, armor, experience and held item name grow from the bottom center, the crosshair and the title from the screen center, the boss bar and the player list from the top center, status effects from the top right corner, the sidebar from the right edge, subtitles from the bottom right corner, chat from the bottom left corner and the action bar from its text.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | size multiplier, 1 is the normal size |

:::

### setScale {#setscale-2}

::: member

Resizes the element with separate horizontal and vertical multipliers; see [`setScale(float)`](#setscale).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | horizontal scale, 1 is the original size |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | vertical scale, 1 is the original size |

:::

### getScaleX {#getscalex}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — horizontal size multiplier, 1 by default.

:::

### getScaleY {#getscaley}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — vertical size multiplier, 1 by default.

:::

### setRender {#setrender}

::: member

Shows or hides the element. Hiding only stops drawing: game mechanics such as chat messages, titles or the hotbar selection work as usual.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `render` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | false to hide the element |

:::

### isRender {#isrender}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the element is drawn (when Minecraft would draw it), true by default.

:::

### reset {#reset}

::: member

Restores the normal position, size and visibility of the element.

:::
